entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The plane whose children vow to reclaim her from Phyrexia.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: What Mirrodin has become after Phyrexia's victory, an engine that consumes and creates malice.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders who conquered Mirrodin, divided into sects.

entities.name: Mirran-Phyrexian War
entities.description: The war ended by Underling Ethu's 263rd report.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: Phyrexian Grand Cenobite who demands humility and speaks of bringing Phyrexia's magnificence to other worlds.

entities.name: Gitaxians
entities.description: The Phyrexian sect of Jin-Gitaxias, who whisper of other worlds.

entities.name: Izathel
entities.description: A priest of the Annex.

entities.name: Machine Orthodoxy
entities.description: The Phyrexian order whose blessings are preached and into which dissenters are sutured.

entities.name: Ria Ivor
entities.description: A White Sun partisan.

entities.name: Underling Ethu
entities.description: Author of 263 reports to his lord, the last of which marked the end of the Mirran-Phyrexian War.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Speaker who says his world is corrupted beyond cleansing and wants to prevent that for others.

entities.name: Avaricta
entities.description: A Gitaxian who speaks of surveillance of Urabrask.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: Leader of the furnace dwellers who decreed 'Let them be' when the Mirran resistance arrived.

entities.name: Kara Vrist
entities.description: A member of the Mirran resistance.

entities.name: Vy Covalt
entities.description: A member of the Mirran resistance who defies a Gitaxian probe.

entities.name: Politus
entities.description: A Gitaxian morphologist.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: Phyrexian Core Augur who seeks the perfect Phyrexia and despises Vorinclex.

entities.name: Sarnvax
entities.description: A Gitaxian.

entities.name: Malcator
entities.description: Phyrexian Executor of Synthesis.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A speaker who tolerates Phyrexians because the dragon requires it.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: Phyrexian Voice of Hunger who speaks of evolution and predators; his forces became fuel for the rest.

entities.name: Azax-Azog
entities.description: A Demon Thane who claims to be the true Father of Machines.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: Phyrexian Lord of the Vault who forged skirges from the dead to safeguard his throne.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: Phyrexian praetor called the Whispering One, who weaves information into a noose for her enemies.

entities.name: Accorders
entities.description: Cherished-land dwellers of Mirrodin who did not live to see its transformation.

entities.name: Koth
entities.description: Koth of the Hammer, who laments the corruption of the mountains and of Phyrexia's Core.

entities.name: Pythor
entities.description: A member of the Mirran resistance.

entities.name: Juex
entities.description: A tormentor exarch.

entities.name: Benzir
entities.description: Archdruid of Temple Might.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: A hunter who opposes Sheoldred's spies.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: Once a pariah, now Mirrodin's greatest hope.

entities.name: Ezuri
entities.description: Speaker who still sees things that lift his heart amid horror.

entities.name: Jor Kadeen
entities.description: Fighter hoping for a pure Mirrodin once again.

entities.name: Minhu
entities.description: A member of the Mirran resistance.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker who writes a journal about the partisans' strange artifact.

entities.name: Argent Etchings
entities.description: Phyrexian scripture.

entities.name: Mirran resistance
entities.description: The Mirran fighters opposing Phyrexia.

events.summary: Mirrans are broken down and rebuilt as loyal servants of the force they had fought.
events.quote: Mirrans were broken down and rebuilt, made to be loyal servants of the force they had fought.

events.summary: Underling Ethu's 263rd report marks the end of the Mirran-Phyrexian War.
events.quote: This marked the end of the Mirran-Phyrexian War.

events.summary: After Phyrexia's victory, each sect begins perfecting its vision.
events.quote: With Phyrexia's victory at hand, each sect began perfecting its vision.

events.summary: When the Mirran resistance arrives, Urabrask decrees 'Let them be'.
events.quote: His decree stunned the others: "Let them be."

events.summary: Vorinclex's forces are partly consumed as fuel for the rest.
events.quote: A substantial portion of Vorinclex's forces became fuel for the rest.

events.summary: Viridian Betrayers hunt their surviving kin to secure a place in Phyrexia's ranks.
events.quote: To secure a place in Phyrexia's ranks, they hunted their surviving kin.

events.summary: Geth forges a swarm of vault skirges from the remnants of the dead.
events.quote: From the remnants of the dead, Geth forged a swarm to safeguard his throne.

relations.note: Jin-Gitaxias despises Vorinclex; Vorinclex scorns Jin-Gitaxias's minions
relations.quote: "I despise Vorinclex and his slobberings about 'evolution.' Only I know true progress."

relations.note: Lord of the Vault with a throne
relations.quote: From the remnants of the dead, Geth forged a swarm to safeguard his throne.
